name: security-review-flask-app
description: Run a security-focused code review on a Flask application — tests the read-only review pipeline.
request: Review this Flask application for security vulnerabilities. Focus on: SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication bypass, insecure session handling, hardcoded secrets, missing input validation, and insecure file uploads. For each issue found, provide the severity (blocker/major/minor), affected file and line, a description of the vulnerability, and a recommended fix with code example.
acceptance_criteria: Flags hardcoded secrets or API keys
Provides severity rating for each issue
Recommends specific fixes with code examples
